data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 4ac06d9827f5e2c22a766daecca421a69692f108
* **host:** macOS (darwin 25.5.0), shared machine, 10-day uptime, 5 users
* **hook:** `stale-terms-check` via `pre-commit-wrapper.sh stale-terms-check 5 check-stale-terms.sh` (.pre-commit-config.yaml:56-58)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (autonomous dogfood discovery)

#### Expected Behavior

A pre-commit hook whose underlying check completes in ~0.077s should pass within its 5s wrapper budget. Per pre-commit-wrapper.sh, the 5s timeout exists to keep the cumulative suite under Claude Code's ~73s ceiling; it should not produce false timeouts for a sub-second check.

#### Actual Behavior

`stale-terms-check` was killed at the 5s budget (exit 124) on 3 consecutive commit attempts while machine load average was 27-38. Direct invocation of check-stale-terms.sh on the same staged files: 0.077s, "no violations found". Direct invocation of the full wrapper in isolation: 4.05s wall (0.89s user + 1.30s system; ~1.9s spent waiting), and it PASSED. Under the full pre-commit run (many hooks forking sequentially) plus elevated machine load, process-spawn contention pushed the wrapped `timeout 5 bash -c` over its 5s budget. The commit succeeded on the 4th attempt once load1 dropped to 13.35. The hook only triggers on commits touching .yml/.md files (stale-terms file filter), so it is intermittent and load-correlated.

Root-cause hypothesis (UNVERIFIED): the 5s wall-clock budget is too tight to absorb fork/exec contention on a loaded shared host; the check itself is not slow. Possible fixes (for triage, not prescriptive): raise the stale-terms budget, measure CPU-time instead of wall-time, or warm the wrapper's read-config.sh/git calls. Safeguard files (the wrapper, the hook) must not be edited without explicit approval.

### 6. Logs

```
Stale Terms Check (5s timeout)...................................................Failed
- hook id: stale-terms-check
- exit code: 124
TIMEOUT: stale-terms-check was killed after 5s
```
Recorded in: /tmp/<artifact-prefix>-<worktree>/precommit-timeouts.log
data.title: [pre-commit-wrapper]: stale-terms-check 5s budget exceeded under machine load -> commit blocked (exit 124)
